notes: Bundle-style workspace plan that loads one file per desktop.
Bundle aliases are available anywhere placeholders are supported.
Desktop paths are resolved relative to this file.

Feature flags and their defaults live in the rig flags registry (`rig flags list`); `rig flags enable|disable NAME` stores a machine override in rig.db. Entries carry a `feature` name; a feature that is off disables its entries exactly as `disabled: true` would, so a variant can be paused without deleting its configuration.

A desktop ref can carry a `feature` too. A desktop behind a switched-off feature is not created at all and the desktops after it move up, so `personal-desktop: false` means three desktops, not four with an empty one.

Switching a desktop's feature off also retires it: restore removes a leftover virtual desktop past the planned count that carries that desktop's name, moving its windows to the last kept desktop. Other extra desktops are left alone. `--enable personal-desktop` brings it back.

`experimental-desktop` adds a trailing Lab desktop for evaluating new tooling (currently T3 Code) without disturbing the daily desktops. Switch it off for one run with `workspace restore --disable experimental-desktop`.

`orca-sessions` puts two Orca windows on the Work desktop in place of the Workspace Terminal columns: the default profile (work repos) on screen 1 and a second `--user-data-dir` profile (personal repos) on screen 3. Roll back with `rig flags disable orca-sessions` and `rig flags enable wt-terminals`.
Desktop names (Review, Work, Admin, Personal, Lab) are re-applied on every restore; `workspace name-desktops` re-applies them (and retires switched-off desktops) on demand.

Aliases here are defaults. `{localappdata}`, `{appdata}`, `{userprofile}` and `{programfiles}` come from the environment, and `tools.desktop.aliases` in `~/.workspace/config.json` overrides or adds any alias on one machine (`chrome-profile-work`, `workspace-root`, an app path).
Override a default for one run with `workspace restore --enable NAME` / `--disable NAME`. Inspect with `workspace features`.
